summary: Hafnia Limited filed a Form 6-K announcing a contemplated accelerated bookbuild offering of ordinary shares to raise gross proceeds of approximately USD 300 million, priced in NOK with the Offer Price set via bookbuilding. Fearnley and Pareto act as joint global coordinators and joint bookrunners, with Arctic and Clarksons as joint bookrunners. Net proceeds fund balance-sheet strength after acquiring TORM shares, lifting its stake to 18.19% (including a recent 4,500,000-share, 4.39% purchase), potential strategic opportunities and general corporate purposes. A Euronext Oslo trading halt runs through allocation; watch pricing discount, TORM stake ambitions and overhang.
